title: farever-character-sheet v1
description: A Farever character as an in-game exporter reads it: class, level, the gear worn, talents, skill picks, runes, weapon-skill ranks, and what was observed. Ids are CastleDB row ids from the game's data.cdb. One rule for presence holds at every depth: an ABSENT key is not recorded (the bench leaves the choice open and names it as a gap); null, [] or {} is recorded as none; a path listed in `unreadable` is what the exporter tried and could not read. This schema describes a clean sheet; the bench's reader (bench import) is more forgiving and names every departure. See docs/CHARACTER-SHEET.md.

version.description: The format version. A bench that reads version 1 refuses a higher one with a sentence.

source.description: Provenance. Every field optional; carried and printed, never priced.

writtenAt.description: When the sheet was written, ISO-8601 (2026-10-19T12:34:56Z).

steamBuild.description: The Steam build id the game ran as (buildid in steamapps/appmanifest_3672400.acf).

bootSha256.description: sha256 of the hlboot.dat the game ran from. SHOULD be written when the exporter can hash it: it is the build identity the bench compares with its own install.

name.description: The hero's name. Optional; replaced by a pseudonym before an upload unless the player keeps it.

class.description: The unit id (Warrior, Rogue, Mage, Priest - what ent.Unit.kind holds) or the aptitude id (Fighter, Assassin, Wizard, Cleric), in any case.

level.description: The character level, 1 to the game's MaxLevel (25 on build 25959898).

gear.description: The equipment, keyed by slot id. A combat slot that is absent is not recorded; one that is null is empty. Keys without the Slot_ prefix (Weapon1, FingerLeft) are read with a note; non-combat slot ids (Slot_Mount, Slot_Glider, tools, bags, consumables) are named and ignored.

talents.description: Talent points SPENT: {talent node skill id: points}. A node a socketed DemonSigil grants costs no point and is left out (listed at 1 it is accepted and normalised away). {} = no point spent.

weaponSkills.description: Arsenal picks. Keyed by Slot_Weapon2, or by a weapon item id (a dump of HeroSpecialization.arsenals). Applied only to the weapon worn in Slot_Weapon2; entries keyed by the main-hand or offhand weapon's id, or by an unworn weapon's, are dormant and ignored with a note. The slot key Slot_Weapon1 is the main hand's own pick, read at level 1 where the hand holds one of its two skills (from level 2 it holds every one, and a list naming them all is read for its order only).

classSkills.description: Class skill bars, keyed by the game's skill type id.

ClassSkill.description: HeroSpecialization.skillSlots, positional; null is an empty position.

MageConduit.description: The conduits in slot order; the same id may appear more than once.

RoguePoison.description: Reserved: no class has a poison pool on build 25959898, so it is named and ignored.

runes.description: The slotted runes. Recommended: a list of rune (mastery) ids, as HeroSpecialization.skillMasteries holds them - each rune's host skill is found in data. Also accepted: {host skill id: rune id}. [] or {} = no rune slotted.

weaponSkillRanks.description: Weapon mastery per skill: {skill id: rank} with rank an integer or {rank: integer}, as Progress.getWeaponSkillRank reports it. Write every rankable skill (AttackCombo, WeaponSkill, WeaponSubSkill, WeaponPassive) of every weapon worn; a held skill missing from the map reads rank 1, the game's own default.

buffs.description: Statuses active on the hero when the sheet was written. Printed and carried; not priced in v1.

item.description: The item that applied it. Required when id is ItemStatus, the status many consumables share (48 items apply it on build 25959898); write it for any other status whenever it is known.

remaining.description: Seconds left; -1 for a status with no end.

stats.description: The hero's attributes as the game holds them: {attribute id: raw, unrounded value} - never the text the character panel prints. Printed and carried; not compared in v1.

unreadable.description: Dotted paths the exporter tried to read and could not, e.g. gear.Slot_Neck.infusion or talents. Each is named as a gap, and the field is read as absent.

x.description: The exporter's own data, carried and never read.

level.description: The instance level, Gear.level - NOT the item level. 0, null or absent: the row's own level (the game stores 0 on crafted pieces and jewellery).

upgrade.description: Upgrade stars, Gear.upgradeLevel. null = recorded as none, 0 stars.

rarity.description: A rarity id (Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary). On a weapon the ROLLED rarity (Weapon.rarity) - write it on every weapon. On anything else optional, and it must be the row's own.

infusion.description: The InfusionPassive skill id infused into the piece (Gear.infusion); null = not infused.

infusionStat.description: The rating the infusion bonus rolled (Gear.infusionBonusStat): CritChanceRating, FervorRating, ArmorPenetrationRating or SpellPenetrationRating.

infusionBonusStat.description: The game's own name for infusionStat, accepted with a note.

sockets.description: The augment item ids socketed (Gear.slots). Order and nulls are ignored: each augment's own augmentType picks the socket. [] = nothing socketed.

iLevel.description: OBSERVED only: Gear.getILevel(). Compared with the bench's own reading of the same piece; never priced.

x.description: The exporter's own data, carried and never read.
